propositions: Source files with invalid UTF-8 bytes can evade the vocabulary guard by being skipped wholesale instead of failing validation
Unallowlisted matches print complete raw source lines unescaped, allowing long lines or embedded control characters to appear in CI logs
Text-like source extensions must fail closed on UTF-8 decode errors while non-source extensions remain tolerated to avoid false positives on genuine binaries
Diagnostic excerpts must be escaped for non-printable characters and capped at 200 characters with a truncation marker
